name: Password Sign-In Is Locked Out
summary: The user submits password credentials for a locked account, no session is established, and the client receives a lockout-specific result that can drive recovery or alternate authentication guidance.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the identified durable identity is password-enabled and locked out

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Password submitted for an account whose sign-in state is locked out.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt password authentication, detect the account lockout state, and return a lockout-specific result without establishing a session.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and account-status remains locked-out and auth.sign-in.locked-out is visible

sourceReferences.note: SignInResult.IsLockedOut returns AUTH030 and records PasswordAuthenticationFailed without establishing a session.
Canonical lockout surface is defined, but web and mobile implementations remain planned.
Server implementation is reconciled, but scenario implementation remains needs-review until the Account Locked surface is implemented on web and mobile.
